newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mandarin chief's legal action lapses.
newsitem.headline: Mandarin chief's legal action lapses.

text.p: The libel action launched by Mandarin Resources Corp Ltd chairman Chim Pui-chung against executives of the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has lapsed, the SFC said on Wednesday.

The court ruled Chim had failed to identify any publication of defamatory nature any ruled the aqction would be permantly stayed unless he substituted a new statement of claim by October 15. He did not do so and the action has lapsed, the industry watchdog said in a statement.
Chim was not immediately available for comment.
